drafts.title: Gist
drafts.pitch: The user pastes a whole year of email and asks for the gist; the room floods with token blocks, and Cursor surfaces on top of the pile with a one-line summary: everyone's circling back.
drafts.reason: Funny 7, clear 8, in-world 7, fresh 6. The token pile filling the room is close to Max Tokens, Waited and Thumbs Down in the last 14 days, and 'circling back' is a stock office joke that doesn't need agents.

drafts.title: No Such Line
drafts.pitch: Cursor asks Null to call a Mars weather tool that doesn't exist, gets nothing back, and reports the weather anyway while the Judge asks who says so.
drafts.reason: Funny 6, clear 9, in-world 9, fresh 6. Null holding a cord to a bare patch of wall is a nice sight gag, but a made-up tool result is the best-known agent joke, and 'Says who?' explains the gag instead of turning it.
